data.title: We help organizations build what comes next.
data.intro: Nexora is a technology partner for organizations that want to move forward with confidence. We bring together engineers, designers and data specialists who work alongside your teams to plan, build and run the technology behind your next chapter.

children.text: We started Nexora with a simple belief: technology works best when the people who rely on it help shape it. That is why we work inside your teams, share what we know and leave you more capable than we found you.

Our work spans cloud platforms, data and AI, and the digital services that sit on top of them. Whatever the starting point, we focus on clear outcomes, steady progress and choices you can explain to your board, your colleagues and your customers.
How we are organized
We keep teams small and multidisciplinary. Each engagement has one accountable lead, a clear plan and regular reviews, so you always know where things stand.

data.title: Privacy notice
data.intro: This sample notice explains how this website handles information. Replace it with your own before publishing.

children.text: This website does not use analytics, advertising cookies or third-party trackers, and it does not store messages sent through the contact or careers pages. Those forms prepare an email in your own email app; nothing is sent until you send that email.
Your enquiries and applications
When you write to us, we use your details only to reply and, for applications, to run our hiring process. We keep correspondence for as long as needed for that purpose and delete it on request.
Contact
Questions about privacy can be sent to the enquiries email shown on the contact page.

data.title: Cloud & Infrastructure
data.intro: We design, migrate and run the platforms your teams build on, so infrastructure becomes a reason to move faster rather than a reason to wait.
data.engagement: A short platform assessment, then delivery in planned phases
data.capabilities:
Cloud migration and modernization roadmaps
Landing zones, networking and identity foundations
Platform engineering and infrastructure as code
Resilience, backup and recovery design
Cost visibility and right-sizing reviews

children.text: Most organizations already run a mix of on-premises systems, cloud services and tools that grew up around them. The challenge is rarely choosing a provider; it is creating a foundation that is secure, understandable and ready for the next ten products, not just the next one.
What we do
We start by mapping what you run today and what it costs to keep it running. Together we agree a target platform and a sequence of moves that keeps services available throughout.
Assessment of current workloads, dependencies and risks
Reference architecture and security baseline for your teams
Migration waves planned around business calendars
Automation for environments, deployments and monitoring
How we work with your team

Our engineers work inside your teams rather than beside them. Every pattern we introduce is documented and handed over, so your people can run and extend the platform with confidence once we step back.

data.title: Data & AI
data.intro: We help you bring data together, make it trustworthy and put it to work, from everyday reporting to carefully governed AI services.
data.engagement: A discovery sprint around one valuable use case
data.capabilities:
Data strategy and governance that people actually use
Modern data platforms and pipelines
Reporting and self-service analytics
Applied machine learning and AI assistants
Responsible AI reviews and guardrails

children.text: Data becomes valuable when the right people can find it, understand it and trust it. We focus on a small number of decisions that matter to you and build the data foundations those decisions need.
What we do
Data platform design, from ingestion to the semantic layer
Data quality, lineage and ownership models
Dashboards and analytics shaped with the people who use them
AI use-case discovery, prototyping and production rollout
Responsible by design

Every AI service we build includes clear human oversight, documented limitations and privacy reviews from the start. If a use case is not ready for automation, we will say so and suggest a better first step.

data.title: Digital Transformation
data.summary:
Reimagine how
you work and grow.
data.intro: We help leadership teams redesign services, processes and products around the people who use them, then deliver the change step by step.
data.engagement: A joint vision workshop and a prioritized roadmap
data.capabilities:
Service and customer journey redesign
Product strategy and digital product delivery
Process automation and workflow tools
Operating model and team design for digital work
Change support, training and adoption

children.text: Transformation is not a single project. It is a series of well-chosen improvements that change how work gets done and how customers experience you.
What we do
We combine strategy, design and engineering in one team. That means ideas are tested with real users early, and the people who design a change are the people who help build it.
Discovery research with customers and colleagues
Roadmaps that balance quick wins with longer-term change
Cross-functional delivery teams working in short cycles
Measures agreed up front so progress stays visible
Lasting change
We build your capability as we go. Coaching, playbooks and shared rituals stay with your organization long after the engagement ends.

data.title: Discover
data.text: We listen to your teams and customers, map what exists today and agree the outcomes that matter.

data.title: Design
data.text: We shape the target solution together, test ideas early and plan a sequence of safe, valuable steps.

data.title: Build

data.title: Evolve

data.title: Stay curious
data.text: We ask why before we ask how, and we keep learning from every team we work with.

data.title: Build together
data.text: The best results come from shared ownership. We work inside your teams, not around them.

data.title: Open by default

data.title: Responsible by design

data.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
data.summary: Design and build secure cloud platforms with client teams, and help them run those platforms with confidence.
data.responsibilities:
Design landing zones, networking and identity foundations
Write and review infrastructure as code
Pair with client engineers and share what you know
Shape our internal patterns and playbooks
data.requirements:
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform
Comfort with infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines
A calm, clear way of explaining technical trade-offs
Curiosity about how platforms serve the people who use them

children.text: You will join a small platform team working across several client engagements a year. Some weeks you will be deep in architecture diagrams; others you will be pairing on automation or running a workshop with a client's operations team.
How we work
We work in small, mixed teams with a clear lead and regular time set aside for learning. Most of our work is hybrid, with client visits planned in advance.

data.title: Data Engineer
data.summary: Build reliable data pipelines and platforms that analysts, product teams and AI services can trust.
data.responsibilities:
Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines
Model data so it is easy to understand and reuse
Improve data quality checks and lineage
Work closely with analysts and data scientists
data.requirements:
Strong SQL and experience with a modern programming language
Experience with a cloud data platform or warehouse
Care for documentation and testing
Interest in responsible use of data and AI

children.text: Our Data & AI team helps clients turn scattered information into something people can rely on. As a data engineer you will own pipelines end to end and help clients set up the practices to keep them healthy.

data.title: Product Designer
data.summary: Research, design and test digital services with client teams, from first sketches to shipped product.
data.responsibilities:
Plan and run research with customers and staff
Design journeys, interfaces and prototypes
Work side by side with engineers through delivery
Contribute to accessible, reusable design systems
data.requirements:
A portfolio showing your process, not only the final screens
Experience designing for complex services or B2B tools
A strong grasp of accessibility standards
Confidence presenting work to senior stakeholders

children.text: Design at Nexora sits inside delivery teams. You will help clients see their services through their customers' eyes and then make those services simpler, clearer and more inclusive.

data.title: Delivery Lead
data.summary: Lead multidisciplinary teams, keep work flowing and build trusted relationships with client stakeholders.
data.responsibilities:
Plan and lead delivery for one or two client teams
Keep priorities, risks and progress visible
Coach teams on agile ways of working
Build long-term relationships with client leaders
data.requirements:
Experience leading digital or technology delivery
A practical, people-first leadership style
Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities
Clear written and spoken communication

children.text: Delivery leads make sure good intentions become shipped outcomes. You will create the conditions for teams to do their best work and help clients make well-informed decisions along the way.

data.title: Graduate Software Engineer
data.summary: Start your career on real client projects, with a dedicated mentor and a structured learning programme.
data.responsibilities:
Build features as part of a client delivery team
Learn testing, code review and deployment practices
Rotate across cloud, data and product work
Share what you learn with the wider team
data.requirements:
A degree, bootcamp or equivalent experience in software
Some experience with a modern programming language
Eagerness to learn and ask questions
Good communication and teamwork

children.text: Our graduate programme pairs every new engineer with a mentor and gives you time each week for structured learning. You will work on real projects from your first month.
